long_biography.plain_text:
Angus Robert Marsham Paul built a career in dry-bulk freight before becoming a company director and investor. He worked at shipbrokers in London and Johannesburg, then spent 22 years at Glencore International. There he managed the global coal dry-bulk chartering and freight trading business. The employer role establishes his experience but does not identify Glencore's trading assets or capital as his own.

In 2017 Paul became an independent director of GoodBulk and remains on its board. He was subsequently named among the investors who provided capital to Singapore Marine, the business that acquired SwissMarine. This establishes a personal investment relationship in shipping, although the size and present value of his stake are undisclosed. He also serves on the board of Prime Properties AG, a Swiss real-estate company, but neither his shareholding nor its assets are disclosed. His career and identified investment point to shipping as his current primary industry, while the original mechanism and scale of his personal wealth remain unknown.
